primaryWitnesses.text: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for the LORD’s house, of bright bronze.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
